entries.subject: DAMIT 3659: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3659.txt. Model 3659, version 2019-05-07, pole (217°, -39°), period 5.73561 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 133.43 ± 2.06 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 209 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 3660, pole ['43', '-34'], [Model 3660](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/3660) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 3660: pole (43°, -34°), 5.7356 h, version 2019-05-07. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "66.715 km (approximate thermal scale)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 133.43 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 149, DAMIT model 3659 diameter 117 ± 3 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 3659 fitted to 3 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
